verdict.rationale: The only scheduling-related evidence is the claim that dbt Projects on Snowflake lets you "develop, deploy, orchestrate, and observe" transformations. Snowpipe and streams describe event-driven loading and change capture, not scheduled recurring jobs, and dynamic tables appear only as a release-note title. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a scheduling primitive (e.g., cron/interval-based tasks or task graphs), scheduling of non-dbt workflows, AI-native or programmatic schedule management, and independent hands-on corroboration.
